title.zh: 从频道中踢出指定终端用户

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于将指定终端用户从频道踢出。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to remove one or more users from a channel.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live remove-terminals --app-id aec0000 --channel-id testId --terminal-ids 18110000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live RemoveTerminals --region cn-hangzhou --TerminalIds.1 18110000 --AppId aec0000 --ChannelId testId
